external_theorem: Silverman, The Arithmetic of Elliptic Curves, Proposition VII.3.1(b): reduction at a good prime p is injective on torsion of order prime to p.
method: For the first good prime p0, any possible torsion prime ell is either p0 or divides #E(F_p0). For each candidate ell, find another good prime p != ell with ell not dividing #E(F_p).
claim_boundary: The finite point counts are independently replayed by audit.py; the good-reduction injectivity theorem is an external mathematical input.
